agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION  Chair  Erik Peña
REGULAR MEETING  Vice Chair  Stephany Gonzalez
  Commissioner  Gen Escobosa
Notice of Cancellation  Commissioner  Roman Rodriguez
  Commissioner  Diana Miranda-Dzib
June 11, 2025 7:00 PM

  NOTICE OF MEETING
  CANCELLATION

  OF THE FOLLOWING:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE PLANNING COMMISION

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the regularly scheduled meeting
of the Planning Commission of the City of Baldwin Park scheduled for
Wednesday, June 11, 2025 has been CANCELLED

  Said meeting was to be held in the Council Chambers,
  14403 E. Pacific Ave., Baldwin Park CA, at 7:00 pm.

  The Next Regular Meeting of the Planning Commission is to be
  announced at a later date.

  Notice of Cancellation was posted on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the
  meeting.

  Dated this 5th day of June, 2025
  Nick Baldwin
  Planning Commission Secretary
